title: Louvre Museum Skip-the-Line Entry Ticket
description: Timed-entry ticket that lets you skip the general admission queue at the glass pyramid and head straight into the museum to explore at your own pace.
imageAlt: The glass pyramid entrance of the Louvre Museum
highlights: Skip the general admission queue at the pyramid
Self-guided access to all permanent collections
Valid for one full day inside the museum
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before your slot
excludes: Audio guide (available on site for a fee)
bestFor: First-time visitors who want to explore independently

title: Louvre Guided Highlights Tour: Mona Lisa & Masterpieces
description: A small-group guided tour with a licensed local guide covering the Louvre's must-see works, including the Mona Lisa, the Venus de Milo, and the Winged Victory of Samothrace.
imageAlt: Guide leading a small group through the Louvre
highlights: Skip-the-line entry included
Licensed English-speaking art historian guide
Small-group setting
Covers the Louvre's most iconic works
bestFor: Visitors who want context and stories behind the art

title: Brunelleschi Pass — All-Inclusive Duomo & Guaranteed Dome Climb Access
description: The definitive Florence Duomo experience. Includes guaranteed timed entry to climb the 463 steps of Brunelleschi's Dome, plus 3-day access to Giotto's Bell Tower, the Baptistery of San Giovanni, the Museo dell'Opera del Duomo, and the Crypt of Santa Reparata.
imageAlt: Climbing the 463 steps of Brunelleschi's Dome in Florence
highlights: Guaranteed timed reservation to climb Brunelleschi's Dome (463 steps)
Full access to Giotto's Bell Tower (414 steps)
Admission to the Baptistery of San Giovanni & Gates of Paradise
Entry to the Museo dell'Opera del Duomo
Exploration of the Crypt of Santa Reparata
Pass valid for 72 consecutive hours from first monument entry
includes: Mandatory timed entry reservation for Brunelleschi's Dome
Access to Giotto's Campanile bell tower
Access to San Giovanni Baptistery & Opera del Duomo Museum
Access to Crypt of Santa Reparata
excludes: Live human tour guide (audio guide included)

title: Florence Duomo & Brunelleschi Dome Climb VIP Guided Tour
description: Ascend the iconic dome with an expert licensed art historian. Skip long lines, discover Renaissance architectural engineering, and take in panoramic 360° views from the rooftop lantern terrace.
imageAlt: Vasari's Last Judgment frescoes inside the Florence Duomo cupola ceiling
highlights: Priority skip-the-line entrance to Santa Maria del Fiore & the Dome
Expert commentary on Brunelleschi's engineering feat
360° panoramic Florence city vistas from the open-air lantern
Includes 72h pass to Giotto's Tower, Baptistery & Duomo Museum
bestFor: Visitors who want expert context on the dome's history

title: Giotto Pass — Bell Tower, Baptistery, Museum & Crypt
description: Perfect for travelers who want stunning Florence views without climbing the Dome. Climb the 414 steps of Giotto's free-standing Bell Tower, and visit the Baptistery, Duomo Museum, and Crypt.
imageAlt: Giotto's Bell Tower Campanile in Piazza del Duomo Florence
highlights: Climb 414 steps of Giotto's Campanile for the best panoramic view of the Dome
Direct entry to the octagonal Baptistery of San Giovanni
Admission to the Opera del Duomo Museum
Discover the Crypt of Santa Reparata
bestFor: Visitors who prefer not to climb inside the Dome

title: Uffizi Gallery Skip-the-Line Entry Ticket
description: Timed-entry ticket to the Uffizi Gallery. Skip the ticket-office queue and go straight in to see Botticelli, Michelangelo, and Raphael at your own pace.
imageAlt: The Uffizi Gallery courtyard in Florence
highlights: Skip the ticket-office queue
Self-guided access to all permanent galleries
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before your slot

title: Uffizi Gallery Afternoon Discount Ticket (4 PM Entry)
description: A lower-priced timed-entry ticket for visits starting at 4:00 PM or later — a quieter, more affordable way to see the Uffizi in the late afternoon light.
imageAlt: Uffizi Gallery corridor in late afternoon light
highlights: Discounted rate for late-afternoon entry
Typically quieter than daytime slots
Same access as the standard ticket
bestFor: Budget-conscious travelers and photographers wanting quieter galleries

title: Lindt Home of Chocolate Entry Ticket
description: Timed-entry ticket to the Lindt Home of Chocolate, including the interactive multimedia exhibition and the giant chocolate fountain.
imageAlt: The Lindt Home of Chocolate building in Kilchberg
highlights: Timed entry to skip the ticket-office line
Access to all seven interactive chocolate worlds
See the world's largest chocolate fountain
bestFor: Families and chocolate lovers visiting from Zurich
